selection: Highest per-tile human-Val F1 among baseline/data_v2/data_v3, with each cutoff selected on 0.05..0.95 step .01, IoU .5; ties favor higher cutoff. No Test use.
training_supervision: 568 original human boxes plus 49 assistant-visual-reviewed boxes; 8 images including one assistant-reviewed negative; not all-human GT.
validation_limits: 49 positive instances on four overlapping 1954 Oildale tiles; 1992 has negatives only. Data_v2 has three 1992 FP vs baseline two at their selected cutoffs. Validation/tuning, not final Test performance.
